purpose: Teach: 戦隊/唐辛子/車いす/垣根/熱海/ウェディング/アロハ/ミント

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、戦隊もの卒業したろ?
lines.en: So you finally grew out of sentai shows, huh?
lines.style: Light, teasing lob. Casual half-smile in the voice. Testing him like you've seen something mildly embarrassing. Not mean — just enjoying the opening.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、唐辛子の辛さに弱いよな、桜
lines.en: Oh yeah? Well you can't handle anything spicy, Sakura.
lines.style: Quick counter-volley. Dry, almost bored delivery masking the fact he's been waiting for an opening to say this. The slightest lift at the end — gotcha.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、車いすバスケのボランティアやってんだろ?
lines.en: Wait, you're doing wheelchair basketball volunteering?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity cutting through the banter. Slight lean-in. She's actually interested now, not performing. Softer attack than before.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、社会で垣根のあるご近所の単元やったろ?桜
lines.en: And you covered that whole unit about neighborhood divides in social studies, didn't you?
lines.style: Quiet, matter-of-fact observation. He's been watching her too. Small smile underneath — she doesn't get to be the only one paying attention. Steady eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で熱海に行ったろ?
lines.en: You took a family trip to Atami, right?
lines.style: Softer now. She's shifting — less attack, more actual interest in him. Genuinely wondering what he'll say. The rhythm slowing down.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ウェディング雑誌、見てたろ?桜
lines.en: But you were totally looking at wedding magazines, Sakura.
lines.style: Caught her off-guard tone. Light, almost gentle — not mean-spirited, just matter-of-fact that he knows things about her too. The wry smile is affectionate here.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、夏祭りでアロハ着てたな
lines.en: You wore that aloha shirt at the summer festival, didn't you.
lines.style: Quieter observation. Less sparring — she's remembering something specific about him. A small warmth underneath. Not a question anymore, a moment of noticing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ミントガム噛んでばっかだな、桜
lines.en: All you ever chew is mint gum, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender delivery. He's moved past teasing now — this is just him noticing her, small habits, genuine fondness. The wry edge melted away.
